title: sao SEC0/SEC1: ETag header safety with special chars in message_id
description:
ETag generation at feed.rs:305-314 uses message_id directly after strip_angles(). If message_id contains " or \ chars, the resulting ETag header becomes malformed per RFC 9110 §8.8.3. Currently masked by fallback at line 327-328 which silently degrades to W/"feed", losing semantic identity.

Oracle: RFC 9110 §8.8.3 (ETag header syntax), RFC 2822 §3.6.4 (Message-ID format).

Fix: either (a) hash the message_id to a safe token, (b) escape quotes/backslashes, or (c) document why current degradation is acceptable.
